workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation host runtime observation adapter IAU candidate

publicSequencingMarker.title: Next governed lane candidate: host runtime observation adapter

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can validate supplied public-safe discovery observations through the existing host runtime discovery, preflight, and validation command chain. It still lacks an admitted public-safe observation adapter that can produce sanitized observation facts without retaining raw private paths or raw registry output.

splitDecision.reason: Host runtime observation facts are the smallest useful step after host runtime discovery proof. The lane admits public-safe observation shaping without opening raw private path disclosure, raw registry retention, arbitrary filesystem walking, PATH or environment probing, runtime validation execution, compare execution, LabVIEWCLI execution, Docker orchestration, terminal process wiring, proof-out expansion, package/bin publication, release, Marketplace, or source copying.
splitDecision.observationBoundary: produce sanitized source-class, availability, role, version, bitness, candidate count, and blocked-reason facts for the existing host runtime discovery contract; do not retain raw private paths or raw registry output
splitDecision.windowsBootBoundary: no new Windows boot is required for bridge or admission; a later proof turn may exercise the admitted observation surface on Windows only after public admission and implementation merge
doNotAdmitTogether: arbitrary filesystem walking beyond the admitted bounded observation policy
